articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu expressed concerns to CNN about the US sale of F-35 fighter jets to Turkey, stating it could disrupt the regional balance of power and highlighting Ankara's ties to Hamas and the Muslim Brotherhood.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned in a Fox News interview that providing F-35 fighter jets to Turkey could upset the Middle East power balance and threaten Israeli air superiority, raising concerns about Turkish President Erdogan's intentions.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu asserted in a Fox News interview that the US-Israel alliance remains strong and that he has an excellent relationship with Trump, emphasizing agreement on major issues including Iran's nuclear program.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu announced in a Channel 14 television interview his intention to build a broader coalition government by ending the political boycott against him, framing it as necessary for managing Israel's external threats and internal divisions.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu aiming to prevent strengthening of US-Turkey ties, F-35 deal
articles.summary: Netanyahu conducted two consecutive Fox News interviews strategically timed before Trump's NATO Summit meeting with Turkish President Erdogan, using media appearances as diplomatic pressure to prevent the F-35 fighter jet sale to Turkey.
